primary_goal: Guide mobile shoppers to explore featured seasonal promotions, browse product categories, or search and purchase products online/via store pick-up.

friction_points.issue: Hero banner lacks a high-contrast action button (CTA), using a subtle text link instead.
friction_points.evidence: In the first slide banner ('Für Euch da, damit das Fest besonders wird'), the navigation prompt is a plain text link '-> Zu unserer Weihnachtswelt' without button visual styling.

friction_points.issue: Excessive text blocks and accordion lists mid-page increase mobile vertical fatigue and hide valuable trust/payment elements.
friction_points.evidence: Screenshots 8, 9, 10 contain multiple paragraphs of text ('Hier bin ich Mensch, hier kauf ich ein', long bullet points) and lengthy category drop-downs before reaching payment methods.

friction_points.issue: Key trust seals and security badges (EHI Online-Shop, Apotheken-Prüfsiegel) are placed deep at the bottom of the long mobile homepage.
friction_points.evidence: In screenshot 12, the 'EHI Geprüfter Online-Shop' badge and pharmacy legal verification badge appear only after scrolling through 11 screen heights.

friction_points.issue: Category recommendation bubbles lack explicit actionable labels or micro-CTAs.
friction_points.evidence: In screenshot 1 and 2, circular category recommendations like 'Foto-Geschenke', 'Conditioner', and 'Backmischungen' display small text below images without visual tap affordances.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we replace the text link in the main hero banner with a styled primary CTA button, then the click-through rate to the Weihnachtswelt promo page will increase because mobile users recognize tap targets faster.
hypotheses.change: Convert '-> Zu unserer Weihnachtswelt' into a solid blue/brand CTA button with prominent padding.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we add a compact trust bar below the top search bar (highlighting Express-Abholung, EHI seal, and Klarna/PayPal support), then visitor bounce rate will decrease because key German purchasing reassurances are immediately visible above the fold.
hypotheses.change: Insert a swipeable or static USPs/trust badge bar right under the top header banner.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we collapse long SEO text sections into an expandable 'Mehr über dm erfahren' accordion on mobile screens, then users will reach relevant categories and footer services faster, improving navigation depth.
hypotheses.change: Truncate text blocks on mobile into collapsible accordions.

quick_wins: Style the text link '-> Zu unserer Weihnachtswelt' with a distinct background button color.
Ensure consistent touch target padding around circular category recommendations.
uncertainties: Whether mobile users primarily land on the homepage via search engines or directly enter with direct intent to use the search bar.
Performance of the hero banner carousel auto-rotation speed on touch devices.
